ValidUpdater(8) System Manager's Manual ValidUpdater(8)

NAME

ValidUpdater — Update the valid database for revocation.

DESCRIPTION

ValidUpdater is a system daemon that updates revocation database for trustd

ValidUpdater is not intended to be invoked directly, but launchd though launchd.

SEE ALSO

launchd(8) trustd(8)
